# Copilot Instructions

This repository's agent/contributor conventions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root — read it before making changes. It is the single source of truth (repository structure, pnpm/nvm/Corepack commands, the canonical component contract, token/Figma authority, package naming, and the `0.0.x`/`1.0.x` release policy) and is kept in one place so it doesn't drift between tool-specific copies.

This file exists only so tools that specifically look under `.github/` also pick up the same guidance.
